title: Queue units with several run.commands share one {out_dir}: later invocation overwrites the earlier record (RQ-20261022-511e-01 lost eth_4h)
note: [2026-10-22 EXITS-GIVEBACK-W43] MEASURED: RQ-20261022-511e-01 runs exit_lever_ablation.py twice (eth_4h then sol_4h) with the same --out {out_dir}; only the sol_4h numbers reached research/results/ (comms/research/RQ-20261022-511e-01/39769641439/logs/cmd-0.log keeps the eth_4h verdict line only), so the grader saw 1 row of min_rows 2 and parked the unit in needs_review. FIX: give each command its own subdir ({out_dir}/cmd-N) and have the collector emit one row per command, or make the unit validator reject multi-command units that share {out_dir}.
